verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page claims it sends meeting action items into Jira, Asana, and other tools, and it auto-captures action items per meeting. It also lists an Otter API & Webhooks and a native ClickUp action-item integration, but all of this is one-line marketing copy without setup or automation detail. missing for 10: any Linear support, documentation of how the Jira/Asana sync works and whether it runs automatically for every meeting, webhook/API docs for action-item payloads, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Help your team move faster by sending actions items from meetings into tools they already use, like JIRA, Asana, and others.
Clear next steps are automatically captured and assigned from every meeting.
Send meeting summaries and action items from Otter to ClickUp to manage everything in one place.
Otter meeting data connects to any system, including niche CRMs and proprietary platforms, unlocking advanced AI meeting agent workflows.
